name: Baldur Hiltman
original_name: バルドゥル・ヒルトマン
source: A soldier who rose up through the ranks. He trains his body. He was originally a soldier of the Empire, but was disgusted by the difference in rank and left.
translation: A soldier who rose up through the ranks. He trains his body. He was originally a soldier of the Empire, but was disgusted by the difference in rank and left.
